Description: Missing values in any column other than Unit_Price
Unit_Price should not be below Unit_Cost
Product names must use standard title case
Category must be one of ['Computers', 'Mobile', 'Accessories', 'Office Equipment']
Date must be a valid calendar date in a supported format
Dates should be in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD
Columns must have dtypes matching their logical type
Each product must belong to its expected category
